label: March 30–April 05
title: “He Will Swallow Up Death in Victory” —  Easter

items.text: The Savior’s life influences the eternal destiny of everyone who has ever lived or ever will live. His Resurrection connects all of God’s people throughout history, linking those who looked forward to it with faith and those who look back on it with faith.
items.attribution: Come, Follow Me—For Home and Church: Old Testament 2026

items.text: Ancient believers had faith in and longed for their Messiah and Redeemer. As we remember Him, we can feel a profound connection with those who looked forward to Him, united by faith in His divine mission.
items.attribution: Come, Follow Me—For Home and Church: Old Testament 2026

items.text: Jesus Christ has borne the iniquity of us all. Through His atoning sacrifice, all shall be made alive in Him, overcoming the power of death and offering eternal life to all who believe.

Old Testament prophecies pointed to the Savior’s ministry and atoning sacrifice. These accounts reveal the faith of ancient believers and their longing for the promised Messiah, who would redeem all mankind.
items.attribution: Come, Follow Me—For Home and Church: Old Testament 2026

items.text: The stone the builders rejected has become the chief cornerstone. This prophetic declaration signifies Jesus Christ’s ultimate triumph and His central role in God’s eternal plan, despite initial opposition.

The Savior’s suffering and death were foretold in ancient scriptures. These prophecies reveal His willingness to bear our iniquities and pains, demonstrating the depth of His love and sacrifice for us.
He was oppressed, and he was afflicted, yet he opened not his mouth. Like a lamb that is led to the slaughter, he was taken, and with what? By violence. He died for us.
Easter is a joyful time to celebrate the Savior’s Atonement and Resurrection. We can spread His peace and joy by finding and sharing messages of hope found in the scriptures.
items.attribution: Come, Follow Me—For Home and Church: Old Testament 2026

items.text: The Lord God will wipe away tears from off all faces; and the rebuke of his people shall he take away from off all the earth. He will swallow up death in victory.
The resurrection of the dead cometh. This promise assures us that all who are in their graves shall come forth, receiving a glorious resurrection through the power of Jesus Christ.
